name: M6.Euclid.dense_injective
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP), M6.Euclid.rank p ≤ N + 1 → M6.Euclid.rank q ≤ N + 1 → M6.Euclid.dense N p = M6.Euclid.dense N q → p = q
guidance: Polynomial.ext on coefficient indexi. Ifi<N+1, extract the matching List.ofFn entry. Otherwise both coefficients vanish by degree bounds, splitting zero polynomial when converting rank to natDegree. Thus truncated arrays are faithful when the invariant holds. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.
